The batch therefore emphasizes matched loading and ratio contrasts around these regimes, while retaining compact controls for calibration.","batch_rationale":"The batch combines failure repair for severe donor, basic-aromatic, carbonyl, ester, and completion-tail regions with local response probes for m29, m157, m81, m61, m123, and related scaffolds. Compact hydrophobic and weakly interacting controls constrain overcorrection.
